Overview

Cebu City is a city in Cebu with a population of 964,000. The Queen City of the South, a historic port metropolis and the Philippines’ premier hub for business and tourism outside Manila. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. The population skews young, with a median age of 25.0.
